Event: Kelbury summit at Yordale Hall. Host: Galen Morcroft. Attendees: 20. Catering: Plated dinner.

Staffing: Wren out; Pia covering. Mira out; Esme covering.

Room Notes:
- Library annex: Lift slow. Too cold all day/evening. Coffee working. Keep clear for Dell’s visitors.
- Loading bay: Lift slow. Repainting (noise evening). Too cold afternoon/morning. Coffee working. Keep clear for Finn and Suri’s visitors. Free morning. Umbrella left. Afternoon stand-up moved here.
- North office: Too cold morning/afternoon. Coffee working. Lift slow. Repainting (noise afternoon). Umbrella left. Keep clear for Opal and Ada’s visitors.
- Garden studio: Repainting (noise morning). Coffee working. Keep clear for Pia, Esme’s visitors, Ines’s visitors, and Wren’s visitors. Too cold evening. Lift slow. Morning stand-up moved here.
- Print room: Umbrella left. Free morning. Repainting (noise morning). Coffee working. Lift slow.
- Harbour room: Coffee working. Keep clear for Cora/Una’s visitors. Repainting (noise morning). Umbrella left. Lift slow today. Evening stand-up moved here.
- East wing: Too cold all day. Repainting (noise evening). Keep clear for Teo’s visitors and Hugo’s visitors. Lift slow. Umbrella left. Coffee working.

Other: Hugo wants east wing kept clear for visitors. Need to send Leon morning meeting notes. Pending tasks unchanged.
